issues.on_page: 2600 Operating & maintenance of plant 13,946,152 (p8); GF column Support services - maintenance and operation of plant 12,696,152 (p5)
issues.issue: Split confirmed as line-specific: the statement's GF plant line (p5) matches schedule line 2600 alone and is exactly 1,250,000 lower, which equals the Special Building 'Operational transfer from the General fund' (p10). Every other GF function line ties to the schedule except instruction (-3,450,000) and business services (+3,224,464 Employee Benefit spending). No page labels the transfer, so the attribution is inferred, though the evidence is strong. A group contra is not needed.

issues.on_page: instruction lines 1100-1300, 3500, 6000 = 90,399,767 (p8); Instructional services 86,949,767 (p5); Statement of Activities Instructional services (90,399,767) and Support services (27,926,374) (p2)
issues.issue: The contra plus the -3,450,000 other financing follows the fund statement (p5), which takes the transfer out of instruction. The government-wide Statement of Activities (p2) keeps instruction gross and takes the 3,450,000 out of support services instead. The arithmetic holds (31,376,374 - 3,450,000 = 27,926,374), but the two statements disagree about which function holds the transfer.

issues.on_page: County receipts 321,514 = 2110 County fines and license fees (p7)
issues.issue: The same money is in detail[6] as 'fines and forfeitures'. The categories should match; fines and forfeitures (with review for the license-fee mix) fits the schedule label better.

issues.on_page: Other 2,714,309 = Activities receipts 2,617,623 + Student fees 54,400 + Employee Benefit other non-revenue receipts 42,286
issues.issue: Mixed line. The dominant category is defensible, but the 42,286 part is 'other' in detail[63], so the category differs from the detail.

issues.issue: The page ties this to the social security and retirement account, so it may be reimbursements/refunds rather than 'other'. It has a review flag.

issues.on_page: District receipts 971,980; Activities Fund budget schedule shows Interest income 42,028 separately

Food bought for resale could be 'purchased power/cost of sales'. 'supplies and materials' is defensible.

issues.on_page: School Nutrition shown under 'Special Revenue Funds' in the governmental funds statements (pp3, 5)
issues.issue: The extractor rules list school nutrition as a business-type example, but this report presents it as a governmental special revenue fund, so 'governmental' is correct here. Noted for consistency across reports.
The extractor added the fund name in parentheses; it is not printed on the row. The same applies to disbursements[8] ('... (Special Building Fund)'). The amounts are the printed fund-column values.

Ending investments are printed as a separate asset line on pp1 and 4, so ending_investments (informational) could be 3,636,977. Beginning investments are not shown separately, so beginning_investments null is correct.
